omission.chore: Schedule daily metadata checks and alert a Discord channel when a new build is detected.
omission.evidenceQuote: The plan is to have a schedule trigger fetch the latest version metadata every morning, parse the JSON response, and send an alert to our Discord channel whenever a new build is detected.
omission.reason: The chore is concrete and the post itself is the demand signal; a small metadata-check prototype can be assessed with stated integration assumptions.
